verdict.rationale: Docs show that Claude Code's tool access is extensible via MCP (Google Drive, Jira, Slack, custom tooling) and that the Agent SDK gives developers 'full control over orchestration, tool access, and permissions,' implying configurable gating of external integrations. However, there is no concrete evidence of an engineering-lead-facing admin/allowlist UI or policy enforcement mechanism for restricting which tools/integrations are available to end users.
